notes.title: Purpose 1951
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I am back with a new walking simulator named Purpose 1951.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2889800/Purpose_1951/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33016994/7b121b30e60fec3343b4ad17736d66534c0d5530.jpg[/img]

It was a delight for me to work on Unreal Engine 5's new features such as Lumen and Virtual Shadow Maps. Thanks to them, this new game comes with a new level of visual fidelity.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33016994/e23e2001c8e7e43c9e64351fd174a76b5214dd9c.jpg[/img]

The development has been over and the store page is live, waiting for you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2889800/Purpose_1951/]wishlist[/url]!

Like always, I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoyed making it.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33016994/041b4ce51dca2bc1f17ac16537e7efdb8d0dcc56.jpg[/img]

With love and respect,
Tonguç ːdpglskittenː

notes.title: Bottle Re-creation
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
I have re-created Bottle from scratch, as a separate game on Steam. I have listened to the feedback. The only thing that stayed the same is the charming music.

Go ahead and check out the store page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384850/Bottle/

With love and respect,
Tonguç

notes.title: Chionophile
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
My next game Chionophile is going to be released very soon!

If you liked Bottle, you're probably going to love Chionophile. The music score was composed and performed by Pınar Karabaş. You'll wander inside a beautiful world that presents a nice poem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37888132/6e191e89d2606917bb28fc55d1fcb3b5a67265f7.png[/img]

The second chapter takes place in an open area so you can move faster and going to have the ability to easily reveal the points of interest in the game area.

You can check out the store page from below, so don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432750/Chionophile/

notes.title: Finding the Soul Orb is released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
My new game Finding the Soul Orb has been released!

notes.title: Steam Developer Page Live!
notes.content:
Hello walkers!
Steam now has a new feature, and it is the developer pages!
I have set up my own developer page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/tongucbodur/

Check it out and make sure you  hit the Follow button at the top, so you won't miss my announcements in the future such as upcoming projects and stuff. If you want to follow me on social media, the links to my Twitter and Youtube pages are also on the developer page.

Also from that page you can view which one of my games are on sale,
so you grab'em at lower costs.

If you want to support me further, why don't you also share the page on your Activity Feed
so your friends hear my games, too!

Thanks everyone, and game on! :btlthumbup:

Tonguç

notes.content:

notes.title: Happy New Year, Sales and New Project
notes.content:
Hello Walkers!
It has been a busy year. I want to thank everyone who support my games and wish you all a happy new year.
As now it is Steam Winter Sale time, I have joined the sale with all my 3 games; [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/355760/]Drizzlepath[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/438340]Drizzlepath: Genie[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/463030]Bottle[/url]. You can check out the discounts if you haven't already got the games.
As for a new title, I want to announce another Drizzlepath game is on the way. It contains more variety of content with many landmarks, things to discover and also there will be decent voice acting. There will be more interaction than the previous titles.
A few things left to be done with the project and I will soon submit it on Steam Greenlight.
Until then, take care and game on! ːbtlthumbupː

With love and respect,
Tonguç

notes.title: Update (v1.0.3)
notes.content:
Hello Walkers! 

I have made some enhancements to Bottle, so here's the list;
[list]
[*]Some words on the notes were replaced with less cryptic ones.
[*]Headbob is now more random and realistic.
[*]Some textures were replaced with better ones.
[*]While reading the notes, now the background is first person camera.
[*]Bushes now have no collision.
[*]Some minor fixes.
[/list]

You can always view the version change log in version.txt file in the game folder.

So it is version 1.0.3 and I wish you have a good time enjoying Bottle! ːsnowflakesː

notes.title: Update (v1.0.2)
notes.content:
Hello Walkers! 

Another update to the game, I have fixed the bug about the previously read notes showing up later in the game. Sometimes the same error was also causing the "left-click" icon not disappearing when moving away from the notes. As the bug does not happen every time, I am not 100% sure it is fixed but according to my many test results, it probably is.

You can always view the version change log in version.txt file in the game folder.

So it is version 1.0.2 and I wish you have a good time enjoying Bottle! ːsnowflakesː

Tonguç Bodur
